name: structural-file-graphing
body: The program graph must cover every tracked file in a scanned repository, not only the files a per-language code frontend claims. Today each frontend emits a `file` record only for the files it claims, so shell, YAML, JSON, TOML, XML, Dockerfile, Makefile, INI, Ruby and plain-text files never get a `File` node and can never be a task target or an `implemented-by` target: the durable spec's spine cannot reach packaging/config surfaces, the verify gate's derived solution coverage cannot see them, and graph-first navigation must maintain an explicit "not in the graph" artifact class. This requirement is delivered by one bundled structural scanner that emits a `File` node for every tracked file it claims plus the structure of the text formats, shipped in the base package with no scan-time dependency. It decomposes into the sub-requirements below.
